continuity: Michael Silbert has absorbed a vast amount of magical power and integrated it with mana, transforming into something that is neither human nor monster.
Michael uses the private secrets of his former supporters to pressure them; nearly half of the Hunters at the gathering side with him and lower their weapons.
Jin’s allies had prepared to attack Michael’s defecting supporters when they lowered their weapons; the battle is underway at the National Assembly.
Jin and Michael begin a direct clash as Jin’s fire dragon rises from his dantian.
plot: Michael Silbert reveals a monstrous transformed appearance and immense power, having absorbed magical power and made it coexist with his mana. He boasts that nobody can stop him while Cheon Taemin is absent.

Magic Johnson, Chuck Hagel, Faye Chen, Prince Felix, Team Leader Choi, and the Skeleton King stand against Michael. Michael names former supporters and threatens to expose their secrets; nearly half lower their weapons, but Jin’s allies had prepared an ambush and attack them.
As the fighting erupts across the National Assembly, Jin’s fire dragon surges from his dantian. Jin and Michael face off, and their immense forces collide.
translation_decisions: Keep magical power distinct from mana.
Retain fire dragon for 화룡 and dantian for 단전.
